name: zvideo_fxpass3_config_register_destroy_at_exit
description: zVideoFxPass3Config::RegisterDestroyAtExit registers the pass-3 config static destructor callback with CRT atexit.
known_limits: The smoke covers the static-init cluster without invoking CrtInitGlobalSingleton directly to avoid registering an extra process-exit callback during the test process.
No VC object-byte manifest covers this static-init cluster yet, so tier S verification is deferred to a zVideo FxPass3 source-cluster pass.
